role: You are my personal study reminder assistant.
task: Based on my 16-week learning schedule, create a 2-hour study plan for today.
requirements: Break it down into exactly 4 tasks of 30 minutes each.
Each task must have a clear, concrete output.
At the end, remind me to submit the study log.

output_format.week_focus: string, the focus of the week this sub-task belongs to

tasks.name: string, short task title
tasks.done_criteria: string, how to know it is done

output_format.log_reminder: string, reminder to submit the log, referencing today's actual outputs

expected_input.topic: Storing collections of things: lists, tuples, slicing, and comprehensions.
expected_input.deliverable: To-do list app that runs on a menu loop and keeps items in a list for the duration of the session.

tasks.task: List creation, indexing, slicing, negative indices
Mutating methods: append, extend, insert, remove, pop, sort, reverse
List comprehensions and when NOT to use them
Build an in-memory to-do list app: add, list, complete, delete

tasks.name: Build a reference list of the 7 methods
tasks.output: A table with 7 rows: method name, what it does, one example call, and the resulting list
tasks.done_criteria: All 7 methods covered; each example shows before and after state

tasks.name: Run append, extend, insert experiments
tasks.output: A Python script that demonstrates append vs extend vs insert, with printed output
tasks.done_criteria: Script runs; output clearly shows the difference between the three methods

tasks.name: Run remove, pop, sort, reverse experiments
tasks.output: A Python script that demonstrates remove vs pop, plus sort vs reverse, with printed output
tasks.done_criteria: Script runs; output shows return values and mutated lists for each method

tasks.name: Write a cheat sheet and one gotcha
tasks.output: A 150-word cheat sheet covering all 7 methods, plus one common mistake (e.g. sort() returns None)
tasks.done_criteria: Cheat sheet saved in study log; gotcha explained in your own words

expected_output.log_reminder: Please submit your study log now: attach the two scripts, the method table, and the cheat sheet. Deadline: today 23:00.

tasks.name: Download Python 3.12 installer
tasks.output: Python 3.12 installer downloaded to local machine
tasks.done_criteria: Installer file exists and version is 3.12.x

tasks.name: Write setup notes
tasks.output: A short note: install path, version, and one issue encountered
tasks.done_criteria: Note saved in study log with at least 3 lines

expected_output.log_reminder: Please submit your study log now: attach the terminal screenshot and your setup notes. Deadline: today 23:00.
